question.text: Category III AIFs following a 'Concentrated' strategy hold:

answer.text: Typically a small number of high-conviction positions (e.g., 10-20 stocks)

explanation.text: The Logic: Concentrated strategies hold few high-conviction positions (~10-20) for maximum alpha impact. The Trap: Wide diversification or single-asset-class approaches are different. Cross-Exam Context: High-risk, high-return strategy type. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Size concentrated bets carefully — single-stock drawdowns can impact the whole fund.
